name: Carbonara Butter Beans
subtitle: Creamy butter beans with crisp guanciale and Parmesan
description: A quick, savory bean main that combines crisp guanciale with a Parmesan egg sauce and tender butter beans.

ingredients.item: guanciale sliced into lardons if needed
jar of butter beans drained (reserve a few tablespoons of the liquid)

instructions.text: Cook the guanciale in a skillet over medium heat until browned and crisp, about 5 minutes. Transfer it to a plate and leave the rendered fat in the skillet.
Whisk the beaten eggs with the finely grated Parmesan until combined.
Warm the reserved guanciale fat over medium-low heat. Add the drained butter beans and reserved bean liquid, then cook until hot, about 4 minutes.

Remove the skillet from the heat. Stir in the egg and Parmesan mixture, tossing continuously until the sauce thickens and reaches 160°F; return briefly to low heat if needed, without scrambling the eggs.
Fold in the crisp guanciale, divide among servings, and finish with extra Parmesan.
